units.notes: This was a second look at the location only. No other field was researched for this unit.

Latitude.note: The Consumers Energy air permit application to the Michigan Department of Environment, Great Lakes, and Energy from July 2026 https://mienviro.michigan.gov/ncore/downloadpdf/2680095510582273031 gives the plant's address as 10500 N Genesee Rd, Mt. Morris, MI 48458. That is the site of the old Thetford combustion turbine plant in Thetford Township. The site layout map filed with the same application https://mienviro.michigan.gov/ncore/downloadpdf/5676681959702244776 marks the four new turbines on a grid of map coordinates. The map is drawn on a grid in meters for zone 17 north. I fitted the map to four grid corners, at 285,400 and 287,200 meters east and 4,780,800 and 4,782,400 meters north, with an error of about 0.1 meters. The middle of the four turbine marks then falls at 43.15486, -83.62508. In satellite imagery that point falls on the cleared concrete pad of the old turbine plant, just south of the large Thetford substation. The imagery date is unknown. Map pin: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=43.15486,-83.62508

location.review_note: The point moves about 54.5 kilometers, so a person should check it. The permit site map is drawn on a meter grid for zone 17 north. I fitted it to four grid corners with an error of about 0.1 meters and placed the site at the middle of the four turbine marks. That is about 12 meters from the first reading, which was done by eye. The Census address finder returned an error, so the address could not be checked that way.

source_log.note: The permit application from July 2026 names the Thetford Combustion Turbine Plant at 10500 N Genesee Rd, Mt. Morris. Its list of nearby emission sources puts the modeling center at 286,520 meters east and 4,781,378 meters north in zone 17, which is 43.15503, -83.62567.
The site layout map from July 2026 shows turbines 1 to 4 and the secured site boundary on a map coordinate grid.

The equipment inventory form from July 2026 gives the site as 10500 N Genesee Rd with latitude 43.1562 and longitude -83.6284. That is about 270 meters west of the turbines. Its map coordinates point to Flint and look like a typing error in the form, so I did not use them.
The address finder script failed twice because the Census geocoder sent back a page that was not data. The permit map gave the point instead.
